categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Cixing Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the knitting machinery industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of intelligent knitting machinery equipment, especially computerized flat knitting machines. The company also engages in automation equipment and project integration, as well as mobile internet traffic monetization businesses. Its main product lines include computerized knitting machines, simple flat knitting machines, shoe upper machines, and one-line forming computerized knitting machines.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence, Internet of Things, and big data to enhance the intelligence, automation, and efficiency of its computerized knitting machines. It integrates industrial internet for remote monitoring and management, enabling real-time operational insights. The production process is demand-driven, involving precision electromechanical integration, customized components, quality control, assembly, professional debugging, and comprehensive quality inspection. The company also emphasizes innovation in one-line forming technology and multi-functional knitting capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are enterprises producing knitwear products such as sweaters, scarves, hats, fly-knit shoes, and home decorations. The company has accumulated a stable customer base exceeding ten thousand clients, including notable groups like BYD and Jiangsu Guotai Group. The markets served are mainly domestic knitting product manufacturers, with some export activities focused on Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates predominantly within China, with key industrial clusters in Guangdong Dongguan, Zhejiang Tongxiang, Shandong Haiyang, Hebei Qinghe, and Shanghai. It also has overseas presence through subsidiaries and participates in international exhibitions in Italy and other locations. Overseas sales account for about 8% of total revenue, primarily targeting Southeast Asian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Cixing operates mainly in the midstream segment of the knitting machinery supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of knitting machines and related automation equipment. It sources components externally but controls key control systems development internally. The company also provides after-sales services and technical support, integrating upstream raw materials and downstream customer needs through its research institutes and service networks.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven development, focusing on core technology breakthroughs and product iteration. It invests heavily in R&D, maintaining domestic and international research teams, including a postdoctoral workstation. Strategic R&D directions include intelligent knitting equipment, one-line forming technology, multi-functional knitting machines, and digital transformation with 3D simulation and digital design. The company also fosters industry-academia collaboration and aims to expand into smart wearable textiles, electronic skin, carbon fiber composites, and advanced medical textiles.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of knitting machinery products, including computerized flat knitting machines and automation equipment. The company also earns income from mobile internet traffic monetization services such as online reading and e-commerce promotion. Sales are conducted via direct sales combined with sales consultants, supported by after-sales service networks. The company recognizes revenue at the point of product delivery and acceptance or service completion.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ningbo Cixing is a leading enterprise in the computerized flat knitting machine industry in China, holding about 28% market share with significant sales growth. It is recognized as a standard-setting entity and a pioneer in one-line forming technology domestically. The company faces competition from both domestic and international players but maintains competitive advantages through technological innovation, comprehensive product lines, and strong brand reputation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved total operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.22 billion, representing a 9.16% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 283.8 million, up 148.82%, with net assets reaching RMB 3.2 billion, an 8.38% increase. The knitting machine segment accounted for over 87% of revenue, growing 15.22%. The company has shown steady growth in sales volume and production capacity, with a robust financial position and positive cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Cixing emphasizes its strong independent innovation capability, holding numerous patents and software copyrights, and possessing dual domestic and international R&D teams. Its products offer high efficiency, stability, and multifunctionality, including advanced one-line forming technology that reduces manual labor and production cycles. The company provides comprehensive pre-sale, in-sale, and after-sale services, including training and technical support, creating a closed-loop sales and service ecosystem. Its brand is well-established, supported by extensive industry experience and a broad customer base, delivering high-quality, customizable knitting solutions that meet diverse market demands.
